diagnosis: In SubscriptionViewSet, get_permissions() checks request.method in ['PUT', 'PATCH'] to enforce IsSubscriptionOwner, but the downgrade action is configured as methods=['post']. Because the method is POST, get_permissions() falls through to returning only [permissions.IsAuthenticated()]. Any authenticated user can force a downgrade on any victim customer's subscription by invoking /api/subscriptions/{pk}/downgrade/.

POST /api/subscriptions/SUB-9941/downgrade/ HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.cloudsaas.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
